disclaimer.en: Research observables, not trading signals: at 60-120bps/side retail fees, formulaic micro-alphas are not standalone-viable. Rank-IC 0.02-0.05 is the institutional register; materially higher |IC| on small samples is treated as noise or leakage until proven otherwise.

ic_convention: time-series Spearman per symbol: corr(factor_t, ln(P_{t+h}/P_t)); a cross-sectional IC over a handful of symbols is degenerate and deliberately not computed

alpha101.adaptation: inner rank->trailing 60-bar pct rank; outer ts_rank native

alpha101.formula: ts_rank(open - sma(vwap, 10), 60) * (-1 * abs(ts_rank(close - vwap, 60))); vwap = (high + low + close) / 3
ts_scale(sma(close, 7) - close, 60) + 20 * ts_scale(correlation(vwap, delay(close, 5), 230), 60); vwap = (high + low + close) / 3
alpha101.adaptation: scale->ts_scale(60); vwap->(h+l+c)/3; LOW-N ~55 obs on 350 bars

alpha101.formula: sqrt(high * low) - vwap; vwap = (high + low + close) / 3
accel = ((delay(close, 20) - delay(close, 10)) / 10 - (delay(close, 10) - close) / 10) / close; where(accel > 0.25, -1, where(accel < 0, 1, -1 * delta(close, 1)))
alpha101.adaptation: accel divided by close (paper thresholds are dollar-scale); branch rarely fires, usually degenerates to -delta(close,1)
accel/close as #46; #49 omitted (near-duplicate, only threshold differs)
0.001 epsilon kept (dollar-scale constant, negligible at high prices)

existing.note: 8h funding settlements are not index-aligned to 1h bars; IC deferred until an aligned series exists

microstructure.note: no book_top10 data in the lake yet (see docs/DATA.md)

correlation.basis: 1h-timeframe factors only (alphas + mom_z + vol rows); daily rows excluded — mixing timeframes by bar index is nonsense
